---
title: Templates
description: Install apps with the managed data they need from the Cubeship templates repository.
---

A template describes apps, managed databases and stores, and questions the installer needs answered. Browse them in [the catalog](/templates). Their source is [cubeshipd/cubeship-templates](https://github.com/cubeshipd/cubeship-templates), one directory per template.

The catalog validates every directory; your instance reads the YAML at the cataloged commit and validates it again before creating resources. An installation records that commit. Editing a template changes future installs, not existing apps.

A template can ask for a domain, secret or choice through [inputs](/docs/templates/inputs). It cannot include instance credentials, machine names or a literal domain that may collide with an existing app.

```text
https://cubeship.dev/schema/template/v1.json
```

The schema checks the YAML shape. The validator also checks references, engine versions, resource limits and domains. See [Diagnostics](/docs/templates/diagnostics) for error codes.
